question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 C 组：苏格兰 vs 摩洛哥（2026-06-19）90 分钟赛果？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group C: Scotland vs Morocco (2026-06-19) — 90-minute result?
one_liner_cn: 摩洛哥凭更高 Elo 与大赛经验略占上风（约43%），苏格兰阵容齐整不容小觑（约31%），平局概率可观（26%）。
one_liner_en: Morocco hold a clear but not overwhelming edge (~43%) on Elo and tournament pedigree; a fully assembled Scotland sit near 31% with the draw live at 26%.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 45 分（摩洛哥 1827 vs 苏格兰 1782），中立场地下统计模型给摩洛哥明显但不压倒的优势。
key_reasons.en: A 45-point Elo gap (Morocco 1827 vs Scotland 1782) on a neutral venue gives Morocco a clear but moderate statistical edge.

key_reasons.cn: 苏格兰中场核心 Billy Gilmour 5 月 30 日热身赛伤退，球衣号显示由 Tyler Fletcher 顶替，中场控制力受损。
key_reasons.en: Scotland's midfield anchor Billy Gilmour went off injured in the May 30 friendly; squad numbers suggest Tyler Fletcher replaces him, weakening midfield control.

key_reasons.cn: 摩洛哥主力前锋 En-Nesyri 落选、新帅 Ouahbi 首次执教成年队世界杯，不确定性限制了向摩洛哥方向的更大上调。
key_reasons.en: Morocco left out first-choice striker En-Nesyri and new coach Ouahbi is at his first senior World Cup — uncertainty that capped a larger shift toward Morocco.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) -> p_stat SCO 32.3% / Draw 25.8% / MAR 41.9%; bounded evidence adjustment (~1.3pp of max 8pp) -> p_final 31/26/43. 80% intervals from drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity plus evidence thinness. No market inputs of any kind.
